title: (RHBA-2019:3855) cluster bug fix update
portal_summary: Updated cluster packages that fix one bug are now available for Red Hat Enterprise Linux 6.
portal_product_filter: Red Hat Enterprise Linux|Red Hat Enterprise Linux High Availability for x86_64|6|i386
Red Hat Enterprise Linux|Red Hat Enterprise Linux Resilient Storage for x86_64|6|i386

portal_solution:
Before applying this update, make sure all previously released errata
relevant to your system have been applied.

For details on how to apply this update, refer to:

https://access.redhat.com/articles/11258
portal_description:
The Red Hat Cluster Manager is a collection of technologies working together to provide data integrity and the ability to maintain application availability in the event of a failure.

This update fixes the following bug:

* fenced: Node fencing blocked if member leaves and rejoins-without-restart quickly in RHEL 6.9 (BZ#1510500)

Users of cluster are advised to upgrade to these updated packages, which fix this bug.
